text:
olivia_sales: Presales ask from Aurora Bank: need a Canada-only POC (inference + logs). BYOK via customer HSM. Must explicitly block EU regions and provide subprocessor names that could touch metadata. Also want delta pricing vs hosted and peering lead time.

rahul_sre: Short summary: Hosted public API can't guarantee strict CA-only due to control-plane telemetry. Options that meet CA-only: 1) Private single-region install in ca-central-1 (best isolation + BYOK HSM), 2) Dedicated pinned tenant in ca-central-1 with deny rules for EU. If they permit a warm standby, we can allow failover to us-east-1; otherwise Private only.

rahul_sre: routing rule example (human): tenant_pin=ca-central-1; allowed=[ca-central-1]; deny=[eu-*]; failover=[]

paula_security: We can disclose a region-filtered subprocessor summary pre-NDA (cloud infra, logging stack, monitoring). Full inventory requires NDA. BYOK/HSM supported: fastest on Private, supported on Dedicated with managed-HSM. Key onboarding + attestation ~2 weeks typical. Need to know if logs must be pushed to their SIEM.

derek_legal: We can sign an "EU egress prohibition" amendment but must enumerate exceptions (security alerts, emergency patch metadata, legal requests). Ask their counsel to confirm scope. We'll need DPA/NDA contact before full subproc list.

peering_ops: For peering: need CIDRs, ASN, SANs for certs, expected throughput. Interconnect lead time ~5-10 business days; cloud provider dependencies possible. Note: cross-region failover may incur egress charges.

quote-bot: quote-bot: Generated ballpark quote: Private single-region POC (incl. BYOK/HSM onboarding) = "$30k/mo" (monthly) or Dedicated pinned POC = "$20k/mo" + HSM add-on "$3.5k/mo". One-time peering/setup ~ $"1.5k". Final depends on GPU profile and commit.

olivia_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll send NDA + security questionnaire, ask legal contact about exceptions, and confirm whether they accept us-east failover. Please DM me the formal quote and a short ops checklist for the SOW. :thumbsup:
